CorrectionReport.title: CorrectionReport
CorrectionReport.description: User-submitted code-table, radical decomposition, or stroke-root coloring error report for Lingming input method characters.

char.description: Target Chinese character or glyph with an error.

issueType.description: Category of the code-table or decomposition defect.

currentCode.description: Current full code shown in the app (may be empty if unlisted).

suggestedCode.description: Reporter's suggested full or short code correction.

currentRoots.description: Current radical sequence displayed in the app.

description.description: Concise explanation of the decomposition or coding error.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the report. Always starts as open; terminal resolved state is admin-only.

reporterUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reporting user.

reporterName.description: Public display name of the reporter (no email or private PII).

source.description: Entry surface where the report was submitted.

createdAt.description: Immutable server creation timestamp (must equal request.time on create).

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp (must equal request.time on every write).

/correctionReports/{reportId}.description: Collection of user-submitted Lingming code-table and decomposition correction reports.
